concurrency.enforcement: schema_validated and operator-observed. No component in this package spawns a model process, so no component enforces the ceiling at the operating-system level.

limitation: A policy over measured qualification, not a scheduler. Nothing here executes a routing decision; it records which model an operator may ask, under what restrictions.
